definitions.Plumbing Irrigation Pool Market: Addressable total market: new/repipe/remodel plumbing + pool/spa + irrigation (formerly SAM)
definitions.Potential Market Share Tigre: 5% of addressable project construction $ (formerly SOM). Materials Potential = 5% of estimated materials only — the Tigre-relevant slice.
definitions.YTD: Jan–10 same months across years (sparse as-of month excluded)
definitions.material_labor: Plumbing: project$ × plumbing_share(4.5%) split 35% material / 65% labor; pool/irrigation: fittings_share of project = material, remainder labor/other; repipe: fixed fittings$ material + 2× labor proxy
definitions.miami_mesoregions: City of Miami jurisdiction vs county Hub; Hub mesoregions from address municipality regex when present — most Hub rows lack city/ZIP
